paper_metadata.title: WikiSkill: Compiling Agent Experience into Persistent Knowledge for Skill Evolution

excerpt: WikiSkill은 에이전트 실행 경험을 일회성 반성으로 버리지 않고 지속 위키에 축적한 뒤, 이 지식과 실행 가능한 skill을 분리해 회차가 바뀌어도 skill evolution에 활용하는 구조를 제안한다.
changes: Preserved paper-focused explanation, figures, and APA references.
Corrected authors and removed reviewer workflow; bounded acceptance-rate inference.
uncertainties: Persistent knowledge quality depends on the experience-compilation and update policy.
leader_resolution: Independent critic findings resolved; source, figures, metadata and rendering validated. Publication tracked separately.
